source_artifact_path: Postgres schema otterworks_<ns> (documents, document_versions, document_snapshots), seeded by testdata/legacy/seed.py via make seed-legacy
golden_baseline_location: testdata/legacy/manifests/<ns>.json (targets postgres.otterworks_demo.documents rows=2000 checksum=e70001cf6110014dab6e1d80adb40285, document_versions rows=13876 checksum=13bc033b2780a0569d7f2217e85d7303, document_snapshots rows=390 checksum=abe69084205723d6ad79e825b8c752dd at NS=demo)

acceptance_checks.description: documents collection holds exactly the manifest documents row count (2000 at NS=demo).
versions embed as a bounded subarray (or bucketed collection) on their document; total embedded versions equals the manifest document_versions row count (13876 at NS=demo).
order-independent md5 checksums recomputed from the target for documents, versions, and snapshot references match all three manifest checksums.
documents with non-contiguous version numbers are detected and enumerated (not repaired, not renumbered).
snapshots referencing missing documents/versions are quarantined with attribution and enumerated.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: document content carried byte-for-byte, including any embedded control characters
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: not expected from Postgres UTF-8; if encountered the record quarantines with attribution

malformed_record_policy.details: NULL columns become omitted fields; version gaps and orphaned snapshots are surfaced as anomalies, never silently patched.

empty_input_semantics.details: a run against an empty/absent source schema writes nothing and leaves prior target output untouched.
